description: This Scala source file defines an API controller class 'ApiController' for a web service, handling various HTTP GET endpoints related to differences analysis, endpoints, statistics, and request retrieval, using Spring annotations and custom rendering.

classes.name: ApiController
classes.description: A REST controller class providing API endpoints for differences analysis, endpoint info, and request data.

methods.name: proxy
methods.description: Filters data between start and end timestamps using DynamicAnalyzer.

methods.name: endpointMap
methods.description: Constructs a map representation of an endpoint with optional noise filtering and weights.

methods.name: getOverview
methods.description: Returns an overview of differences within a time range, with options to exclude noise and include weights.

methods.name: getEndpoints
methods.description: Retrieves list of endpoints, optionally excluding noisy ones.

methods.name: getStats
methods.description: Provides statistics for a specific endpoint.

methods.name: getResults
methods.description: Fetches difference results for a specific endpoint and path.

methods.name: getIndex
methods.description: Retrieves a specific difference result by index for an endpoint and path.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Retrieves a saved request by ID.

methods.name: getInfo
methods.description: Provides service information and configuration details.

methods.name: httpServiceToMap
methods.description: Converts a service target string into a map with a 'target' key.
